items.title: Scrap junk to produce Lead
items.detail: Craft Bulk Lead at a Tinker's Workbench then scrap it, or scrap junk containing Lead

items.title: Collect a Microscope or Biometric Scanner
items.detail: Find them at West Tek Research Center

items.title: Craft any Flair at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Flairs are cosmetic backpack trinkets from Season Scoreboards or Seasonal Events

items.title: Kill a Blood Eagle
items.detail: Reliable spawn at Dagger's Den in the Mire

items.title: Kill a Honey Beast
items.detail: Found at The Freak Show in the Savage Divide

items.title: Kill a Pint-Sized Phantom while wearing a Costume
items.detail: Wear any outfit with 'Costume' in description; Phantoms appear near cabins and campgrounds

items.title: Take a Camera Picture at the Super Duper Mart in the Burning Springs
items.detail: Equip Camera from Pip-Boy weapons slot and take a picture

items.title: Build Anything in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any decoration or C.A.M.P. piece from build menu

items.title: Collect Ballistic Ammo
items.detail: Pull from stash, craft at Tinker's Workbench, or loot from enemies

items.title: Craft Bulk Steel
items.detail: Craft at Tinker's Workbench using Steel scrap and Plastic

items.title: Craft Bulk Wood
items.detail: Craft at Tinker's Workbench using Wood scraps and Plastic

items.title: Cripple a Super Mutant's Limb
items.detail: Aim at arm or leg at West Tek Research Center; use Enforcer perk or V.A.T.S.

items.title: Kill a Mole Miner
items.detail: Reliable spawn at Blackwater Mine; use V.A.T.S. on head

items.title: Kill an Enemy with a Sharp or Piercing Weapon during a Head Hunt
items.detail: Start Head Hunt at Highway Town Bounty Board; use bladed melee weapon for final hit

items.title: Scrap junk to produce Black Titanium
items.detail: Scrap Mole Miner suits and excavator power armor mods at any workbench

items.title: Sell a Weapon to an NPC vendor
items.detail: Sell any looted weapon or crafted grenade to any vendor

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Double SCORE rewards and bonus Caps from activities throughout the event period.

events.name: Anniversary Events
events.description: Special celebration event marking an anniversary with unique rewards and activities.

events.name: Gold Rush and Double Mutations
events.description: Gold Rush caps bonus combined with double mutation rates on creatures.

events.name: Mutated Public Events
events.description: Public events with mutated variants offering special party packages and rewards.

events.name: Double XP Weekend
events.description: Double experience points earned from all activities for accelerated character leveling.

events.name: Holiday Scorched
events.description: Holiday-themed Scorched creatures spawn throughout Appalachia with festive rewards.
